fieldNotes.location: Confirmed FedEx Ground regional sortation hub at 6000 Riverside Dr, Keasbey NJ (Woodbridge Township), a 24/7 NY/NJ-metro hub on the Raritan River. Roster coordinate (GEOMETRIC_CENTER, moved 1.2 km) landed correctly on the FedEx complex. FedEx Ground branding directly confirmed on the office building and on numerous trailers in Street View.
fieldNotes.campus: The property is a large FedEx Ground campus with two distinct large sort-building clusters (a northwest building with a big solar roof and a southeast building cluster), each with continuous dock banks and surrounding trailer fields, plus a central office building with a curved entry canopy. multipleFacilities marked true.
fieldNotes.truckGate: FedEx trailer yard is enclosed by chain-link fencing (confirmed in 2019/2021 Street View — fenced trailer yard behind the office building). Controlled private campus access off Riverside Dr. Counted as a controlled truck gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A guard booth could not be isolated in satellite — the truck gate is internal to the secured campus and Street View (2019/2021 vintage) does not penetrate it. Marked true with medium confidence: a fenced FedEx Ground metro hub of this scale is universally guard-staffed at its truck entrance. Flagged in uncertainFields.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Likely 2 — separate employee-vehicle and truck-yard entrances, plus possibly a gate per building cluster; exact count is an estimate.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long private campus access roads and deep paved internal yard approaches.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very large paved gate/yard aprons with abundant bypass-lane width.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Two large sort buildings with continuous dock banks and hundreds of trailers backed in — far over 50, estimated ~320 total across both buildings. Honest overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer-parking fields surround both buildings — hundreds of drop trailers, clearly 50+. Estimated ~750 visible / ~900 capacity.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense NY/NJ-metro industrial corridor (Woodbridge Township) — classed Urban.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~125 acres from the perimeter box (developed FedEx campus footprint); no published figure found, estimated from imagery.
